title: fix(app-shell,plugin-grid,i18n): inline-edit saves and draft discard say what they did, read-only reasons reach keyboard and assistive tech, and the lookup rail reads label first (objectui#12303)
body:
Fixes #12303
Clause-②: yes — every locale pack of `@object-ui/i18n` (published) gains the `table.saved` count family: `table.saved` plus the plural forms each pack's language selects (`_one` and `_other` everywhere, `_many` in es, fr and pt, `_few` and `_many` in ru, and `_zero`, `_two`, `_few` and `_many` in ar, mirroring `table.modified` in each pack). It is the text of the grid's new save toast. Additive: no key is renamed or removed, and the changeset declares `'@object-ui/i18n': minor`. The other new string, `engine.edit.draftDiscarded`, is a row in the metadata designer's own `en`/`zh` table inside `@object-ui/app-shell`, not a pack key. No component, export or spec key is added.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (claim comment 6140256037), rows 1 to 6 of the family card. Implementing session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01RZYixBnXPWvcm2YenWo6eJ`.

## What changed, row by row

1. **Row 1, the grid's default inline-edit saves** (`ObjectGrid`'s `defaultRowSave` and `defaultBatchSave`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`). After a landed write they raise the shared success toast, naming the rows the server accepted: "1 row saved", "2 rows saved" (the `table.modified` unit the "Save All (N)" bar counts in). A refused row is not counted (the table keeps it, flags it and shows the reason, as objectui#12309 made it do). A row whose conflict the user answered with Reload latest wrote nothing and is not counted. A batch where nothing landed raises no success toast.
   - **Serial gate, met by content.** objectui#12309 merged at 2026-10-13T07:17:46Z as `3092aca`. `ifMatch` appears 4 times in `ObjectGrid.tsx` at `3092aca` and 0 times at the claim's base `ca45c6d`, and `git merge-base --is-ancestor 3092aca origin/main` exits 0. `origin/main` was merged into this branch (`81a299d`) before either function was touched, so row 1 is built on its per-row outcome and does not race it.
   - The `toast` is the one `@object-ui/components` re-exports from `sonner` (`ui/sonner`), the module `plugin-form`, `plugin-kanban` and `plugin-view` raise. `plugin-grid` does not depend on `sonner`, so no dependency is added.
2. **Row 2, "Discard draft" on the metadata edit page** (`ResourceEditPage`'s `doDiscardDraft`). Once the `DELETE …?state=draft` and the re-read have landed, it raises `toast.success` from `sonner` (the import Studio's publish uses) with "Draft discarded: TYPE/NAME". A refused discard goes to the existing `catch` and keeps showing the page's error.
3. **Row 3, Studio's Field properties rail on a read-only package.** The rail body is wrapped in the record page's Archive pattern (`DeclaredActionsBar`, objectui#11811): it is the tooltip trigger (hovering any disabled control in it shows `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint`), a tab stop (`tabIndex=0`, `role="group"`, named by the rail's title), and is described by an `sr-only` copy of the reason.
   - **Where the producer is.** The rail's inputs and its Remove button are rendered by the shared `ObjectFieldInspector` (`views/metadata-admin/inspectors/`), which `StudioDesignSurface`'s rail mounts. The fix is at the rail (`views/studio-design/`): one wrapper for the rail body rather than one per control. A per-control wrapper would mean a new prop on each shared inspector atom, which the claim fences out, and the reason is the same for every control in the rail.
   - **Bound:** the disabled inputs themselves carry no `aria-describedby`; the rail body that holds them does, and it is in the tab order.
4. **Row 4, Publish and the automation enable switch on a read-only package.** Each moves its `title` into the same pattern: a wrapping span that is the tooltip trigger and a tab stop, and an `sr-only` copy of the reason that both the span and the control are described by. While wrapped, the control takes `disabled:pointer-events-none` so the hover lands on the span. Tab from "Changes" now reaches Publish's wrapper. Writable packages render exactly as before (no wrapper, the old `title`s).
5. **Row 5, the import wizard's disabled "Next"** (`ImportWizard`). It is described by the visible "Can't continue" text (`grid.import.missingRequiredHint`, not re-worded), and a wrapping span (the same pattern) is the tab stop a disabled button cannot be, described by the same text. There is no tooltip: the reason is already on screen, directly above. The id travels to the module-private `StepMapping` as one internal prop, `missingRequiredHintId`. That component is not exported, so no published prop changes.
6. **Row 6, the lookup rail reads label first.** Both pickers live in `views/metadata-admin/inspectors/`, the same package as the claim's `studio-design/` but outside it, and are fixed where they render:
   - `InspectorComboField` (Display field): an option whose label differs from its value leads with the label, and the machine name follows smaller, monospace and muted. The trigger shows a chosen option by its label, in the body font (no longer in the caller's monospace), with no second name, so a label that already spells the name is not doubled there. An option with no distinct label shows its value alone, in monospace, as before. **Blast radius, said up front:** this is the shared combo, so every inspector combo with labelled options now reads label first (the app-nav, report, dashboard-widget, dataset and view-variant inspectors), per the maintainer's objectui#11862 ruling that the label leads everywhere.
   - `ObjectPicker` (Related object): at rest, a committed name the catalog knows shows that object's label, with the name beneath it (small, monospace, muted) as the input's description. Focus puts the name back to edit. A value the catalog does not know (an expression, a name not served) shows as itself, in monospace, as before. What is committed is always the name.
   - Both follow the Studio object header: the label in the body font, the api name in a small muted monospace span.

The Archive pattern is written inline at each site, as `DeclaredActionsBar` writes it: `@object-ui/components` has a helper for it (`DisabledReasonTrigger`), but its header says it is module-private and exported from no entry, so it is reused by shape, and no component is added.

## The dispatch's mechanism hypotheses, measured

1. **Shared toast:** `sonner`'s `toast`. `app-shell` imports `sonner` directly (Studio publish and autosave, the record page). Plugin packages raise the `toast` that `@object-ui/components` re-exports from the same `sonner`. Both are used above, one per package.
2. **Archive pattern:** inline in `DeclaredActionsBar` (and in `containers.tsx` and `record:quick_actions`), with the module-private helper above in `components`. It was reused by shape, not exported.
3. **Row 4's reason:** `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint`, confirmed. The objectui#11124 pin's `title` assertion was moved, not deleted: it now asserts the switch carries no `title`, is described by the reason, and has a wrapper that is described by it too, plus a new Tab case.
4. **Row 5's text:** `grid.import.missingRequiredHint`, associated by id, not re-worded.
5. **Row 6's label source:** Display field options are built from the referenced object's fields (`{ value: name, label: field label, hint: type }`), so the field's label leads. Related object reads the object catalog's label (the served object's `label`). The Studio object header draws the label first and the api name in a small muted monospace chip, and that is what both now follow.
6. **Save All after objectui#12309:** one `update` per row, all attempted together (`Promise.allSettled`), with conflicts put to the user one row at a time and failures handed back per row. The toast counts the rows that landed: fulfilled writes plus conflicts the user resolved with Overwrite.

## Pins (one per row) and their ablations

| Row | Pin | Ablation (mutation applied by `ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit verified on disk, restored to `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `plugin-grid` `inlineEditSaveFeedback-12303.test.tsx` (5 cases) | per-row toast removed: 1 failed / 4 passed. Batch toast removed: 3 failed / 2 passed (the per-row and nothing-landed cases stay green, as they should) |
| 2 | `app-shell` `ResourceEditPage.discardFeedback-12303.test.tsx` (3) | toast removed: 1 failed / 2 passed (the declined-confirm and refused-discard controls stay green) |
| 3 | `DataPillar.readOnlyRailReason-12303.test.tsx` (4, incl. Tab) | wrapper never applied: 3 failed / 1 passed (the writable control) |
| 4 | `StudioDesignSurface.publishReadOnlyReason-12303.test.tsx` (4, incl. Tab from Changes); `StudioDesignSurface.automationsReadOnly-11124.test.tsx` (moved assertion + Tab case) | Publish wrapper off: 3 failed / 1 passed. Switch wrapper off: 2 failed / 6 passed |
| 5 | `plugin-grid` `importMissingRequiredHint.describedBy-12303.test.tsx` (3, incl. Tab from Back) | wrapper off: 2 failed / 1 passed (the button's own description survives that mutation by design; the wrapper and Tab cases go red) |
| 6 | `lookupLabelFirst-12303.test.tsx` (7: combo options and trigger, object picker at rest and on focus, with controls) | combo label-first branch off: 1 failed / 6 passed. Object picker resting label off: 2 failed / 5 passed |

Every ablation ran at `88116eb`. The option-row code the combo ablation mutated is unchanged since then. Only the trigger changed after, and its pin is the plain body-font assertion in the same file. Two first attempts were no-ops, and the tool refused them (exit 1, no test run, file restored): their replacement text was a substring of the anchor, so the count could not rise. They were re-run with non-substring replacements, which gave the rows above.

## Verification

Every line below was run on this branch's final head, `1e7365c` (after merging `origin/main` at `cea429b`), unless it names another sha.

- **Build:** the closure `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` (it holds `plugin-grid` and `i18n`) at `88116eb`, then the three packages the last merge moved (`i18n`, `data-objectstack`, `plugin-calendar`) at `1e7365c`. Both: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Pins and their neighbours** at `1e7365c`: the seven pin files, the two pre-existing pins this PR edits (see below), the objectui#12292 and persistence grid suites, the `ObjectPicker`, Publish (`interfacePolish`) and `layersUnsaved` suites, and `packages/i18n/`. Result: 98 files, 1413 passed, 13 skipped.
- **Package sweeps**, from the repo root with repo-relative paths: `packages/plugin-grid/` gave 208 files and 1913 tests passed, and `packages/i18n/` gave 83 files and 1321 passed (13 skipped), both at `88116eb`. **Declared narrowing for `app-shell`:** its 1320 test files are not run whole locally (CI's sharded `pnpm test` runs them). Run instead, at `88116eb` and `e219230`:
  - `views/metadata-admin/inspectors/` and `views/studio-design/` whole;
  - every other `metadata-admin` test file;
  - every `app-shell` test file that names a changed module (`InspectorComboField`, `ObjectPicker`, `ObjectFieldInspector`, `FlowReferenceField`, `ResourceEditPage`, `StudioDesignSurface`, `DataPillar`, `AutomationsPillar`, `registerBuiltinInspectors`) or renders the inspectors through `SchemaForm`, `FlowPreview` or `FlowInspector`.

  That is 671 files. The first pass found two pre-existing pins that read the combo's old value-first option order: `datasetPickers.authorText-11161` pins the exact option text, and `DatasetDefaultInspector.blankField-11402` found an option by where its text starts. The first now states the label-first order. The second reads the option's value (cmdk's `data-value`). With those two edits: 400 files, then 271 more, all passed. The combo's trigger was then reduced to the label alone (`e219230`), so every test file in those two directories that reads a combobox or a monospace class (103 files) was run again at `1e7365c`: 1317 passed.
- **Type-check** (hyphenated `type-check`, script name echoed) of `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell`. Each compiles its tests (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`). All `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Root `type-check:scripts`, `type-check:vitest-config` and `type-check:vitest-setup` also exit 0.
- **The CI Type Check job's pre-tsc battery**, each exit 0: `check-type-check-coverage`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity` and `check:icon-record-names`.
- **i18n, bytes, citations and changesets**, each exit 0: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (the new keys are not reported), `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check` and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- **ESLint, a declared narrowing** (repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's). The population is the 26 `.ts`/`.tsx` files this branch changes against its merge base, linted with the repo's `eslint.config.js` (`**/*.{ts,tsx}` scope) the way each package's `lint` script (`eslint .`) runs it. Read from `--format json`: 26 files, 0 errors, and 0 findings on any line this branch adds. The warnings the json lists sit on lines this branch did not write. Invariance: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off, and this diff cannot move a verdict on a file it does not touch.

## Acceptance notes (not filed, out of this card's rows)

- **Same family, not in the rows:** on a read-only package, the Automations pillar's flow inspector rail disables its inputs with no reason (the objectui#11124 pin shows them disabled). It has the same shape as row 3, read from code and that pin, not reproduced in a browser. Carrier: this family card, as a candidate row.
- The Studio header's "Create app" button, on a read-only package that ships no app, still carries its reason only as a `title` on a disabled button, the row 4 shape. It is reachable only for that package shape and was not in the claim's named controls.
- The import wizard's "Next" is also disabled, with no reason, when no column is mapped and the object has no required field.
- The runtime draft bar's discard (`RuntimeDraftBar`) raises no success toast either, the row 2 shape on another surface. Read from code only.
- On a writable package with nothing to publish, Publish is described by the visible "nothing to publish" text (objectui#8219) but is still not focusable. Unchanged here.
- The dataset pickers hand the combo a label that already spells the name (`LABEL (name)`, from `datasetPickerOptions`), so with the combo's own secondary name the option shows it twice. It did before as well, value first. The trigger shows the label alone, so nothing doubles there. Passing the plain label to the combo is a follow-up for that helper, not done here.
- NOT MEASURED: a live browser pass. No objectstack backend runs in this container, so every row is pinned through the real components under happy-dom, not in the console.
